hard_rules: additive/optional only; frozen field meaning unchanged: coordinate.source_frame, coordinate.reference_frame, coordinate.horizontal_basis, coordinate.ground_frame, coordinate.ground_relative_available, coordinate.transform_status
the ground-derived transform is stored only under a new ground_derived block; it must NEVER be written into measured extrinsics (T_reference_lidar, rotations, frames.reference, extrinsics_verified)
presence of ground_derived never implies a verified physical pose; all physical flags stay false until measured
HF-01 health/manifest v1 unchanged; bump schema_version only if a frozen field meaning/enum changes

A_ground_derived_block.loader_rule: reject a ground_derived block whose nested schema_version is missing or is not the supported value; do not guess/merge

fields.x_reference_axis_source: confirmed source reference axis used for u
fields.convention: o=-d*n; u=proj(a); v=n x u; R=[u;v;n]; heading/origin are conventions

applicability.single_plane_note: software precondition (fixed mount, flat indoor, one dominant plane); true means the assumption was declared, NOT that the field was confirmed
applicability.confirmed_note: field confirmation flag; false until measured/confirmed; never hard-coded true

per_candidate.bbox_ground_min_m: [x,y,z] or null; per-axis min over the candidate's ACTUAL transformed points
per_candidate.bbox_ground_max_m: [x,y,z] or null; per-axis max over the same points
per_candidate.center_ground_m: [x,y,z] or null; DEFINED as per-axis median of the candidate's ACTUAL transformed points (not a rotated source median)
per_candidate.bbox_ground_from: actual_points | unavailable (never from only the source min/max two corners)

coordinate_additions.ground_derived_id: id of the ground_derived artifact that produced the box; null if none
coordinate_additions.note: the existing coordinate.ground_frame string is LEFT AS IS; it is not repurposed as the transform id

C_state_consumption_consistent_with_cand.rule: state exposes the SAME derived geometry and version binding as the candidate snapshot: center_ground_m, bbox_ground_min_m/max_m (per-axis median/AABB of actual transformed points), coordinate.ground_derived_id, calibration_id/version
C_state_consumption_consistent_with_cand.binding: state and candidate must reference the same ground_derived_id and source frame id; a mismatch means the box is stale and must not be shown as current
C_state_consumption_consistent_with_cand.frozen_fields: position_source_m / bbox_source_* keep their meaning; add parallel ground fields only

D_frontend_and_legacy: enable ground mode only when ground_derived_id matches the loaded artifact AND physical_verified is read (false => label unverified/preview)
unknown/missing/newer nested version => ground mode disabled, fall back to source view; never default to valid/green
all additions optional: v1 clients ignore them and keep source behaviour
2D selection rectangle derived from the same ground AABB eight corners; selection still sends source snapshot_id/candidate_id, not pixels
E_recalibration_invalidation: a new ground_derived_id/calibration_version invalidates old snapshots, positions and standing-baseline eligibility
source seq/stamp_secs/stamp_nsecs/time_epoch are preserved and compared unchanged
monitoring only regions with trusted ground support; insufficient support => unknown/degraded; sustained change => require recalibration (no claim of full yaw/horizontal-drift detection)
